club_info.title: The Association
club_info.watermark_sub: Everything for the plant - Everything for the club
club_info.description: We are a non-commercial association, based in Buchholz in der Nordheide, which is financed by membership fees. Now, after receiving the license, we as Cannabis Social Club Nordheide will focus exclusively on providing our members with comprehensive information and providing a limited quantity of high-quality cannabis products for personal consumption within legal requirements. We place particular emphasis on a professional and sustainable way of working, a special, exclusive selection of strains and high-quality products for our members!

safety.title: Stay Safe
safety.subtitle: Protected Space
safety.description: As Cannabis Social Club Nordheide, we attach great importance to prevention, youth protection and health protection. Our prevention officer ensures that all measures to protect members are complied with and offers support for members with problematic consumption behavior.
safety.warning: Please note that the purchase of cannabis products will be exclusively reserved for our valued members. Inquiries regarding the acquisition of cannabis products without the intention of joining our association will remain unanswered on our part. As a responsible association, we attach the greatest importance to the safety and satisfaction of our members. We decisively distance ourselves from illegal activities and commit ourselves to conscientiously complying with the strict requirements of the Cannabis Act.

concept.title: Youth and Health Protection Concept
concept.subtitle: KCanG Guidelines on Child and Youth Protection
concept.intro: Excerpt from our concept (§2). We are committed to the following points:

child_protection.title: Child and Youth Protection
child_protection.content: Notifications within the cultivation association regarding the KCanG in relation to child and youth protection.

signage.title: Signage
signage.content: To attract little attention, external signage is largely avoided and restricted to the bare essentials. In every entrance area of the association's properties, signage will indicate that access is prohibited for children and adolescents under 18 according to KCanG.

applications.title: Membership Applications
applications.content: When applying for membership, the applicant is explicitly informed about the prevention concept, the KCanG regulations, and the BzgA documents "Information on Cannabis & Important Notes on Cannabis Consumption." This is done by providing these in paper form or as a digital document during the online application. By signing the application, the member confirms they have read and accepted this information.

brochures.title: Brochures
brochures.content: Both the KCanG and BzgA information materials are clearly displayed within the cultivation association's premises.

entrance_controls.title: Entrance Controls
entrance_controls.content:
A membership card is issued to every member of our association. This card is used for access to the distribution rooms and for verifying collection data.
When entering an association property, the member is additionally checked by a distributing member or a representative using their photo ID in case of identity doubts.

advertising_ban.title: Advertising Ban
advertising_ban.content: No signage. No advertising or sponsorship. The association does not run advertisements. Existing social media accounts are only used for information purposes.

minimum_distance.title: Minimum Distance
minimum_distance.content: Every association property is located more than 200m away from schools, child and youth facilities, and playgrounds.

property_protection.title: Property Protection Measures
property_protection.content: External signage of the association's properties is completely avoided. Our properties have a doorbell sign at the entrance to the association rooms. Any other external signage is omitted.

product_protection.title: Product Protection Measures
product_protection.content: Cannabis consumption goods (cannabis flower and hashish) are distributed in childproof, neutral containers. Additionally, a product description is included, which specifies the THC/CBD content, health risks, and usage instructions, explicitly requesting that the product be kept away from children and adolescents.

child_welfare.title: Handling Child Welfare Endangerment
child_welfare.content:
The association has no contact with children or minors during its activities. If it becomes aware that members are passing on shared cannabis or propagation material to minors, the statutes specify that such behavior leads to immediate expulsion.
Distributing members are informed about the reporting chain and measures to take in case of child welfare endangerment. Essential documentation explaining these actions is provided in their workspace. The member must ensure that the prevention officer or a board member is notified immediately to initiate measures with local youth welfare services.

youth_institutions.title: Contact with Youth Protection Institutions
youth_institutions.content: The association has no regular contact with youth welfare institutions. An agreement is being developed with local youth welfare services on how to establish low-threshold contact between the association, affected members, and the welfare office when needed.

entry_ban.title: Entry Ban for Property
entry_ban.content: The instruction that distributing members must complete ensures they have the necessary knowledge and skills to comply with laws and guidelines and to enforce the entry ban for children and adolescents.

instruction.title: Member Instruction
instruction.content: All distributing members, as well as board members and other responsible parties, are instructed by the externally trained prevention officer in child and youth protection, health protection, and prevention.

special_measures.title: Special Measures (18-21 Year Olds)
special_measures.content: Members aged 18–21 have a membership number clearly indicating that a maximum of 30 grams of cannabis per month (max 25g per day) with a maximum 10% THC content may be distributed.
